test_RollingStatsModel_fit_predict: test the RollingStatsModel fit_predict method with various score functions and window sizes on time series data
test_RollingStatsModel_irregular_granula: test the RollingStatsModel on time series data with irregular granularity patterns and missing points
test_RollingStatsModel_sudden_granularit: test the RollingStatsModel on data with sudden changes in data granularity from hourly to minute intervals
test_RollingStatsModel_error_handling: test the RollingStatsModel error handling for parameter errors, data errors, and insufficient data scenarios
test_RollingStatsModel_expanding_window: test the RollingStatsModel with allow_expanding_window enabled to score data without separate historical data
